data.one_liner: A carousel widget with multiple layouts and infinite loop support
data.what_it_does: Provides a Swiper widget that can display items in horizontal or vertical orientation with optional pagination and control buttons. It supports custom layouts and animations via PageTransformer and CustomLayoutOption.
use_when: implementing a carousel or slider in a Flutter app
needing infinite looping or custom page transitions
requiring built‑in pagination or navigation controls
avoid_when: you only need a simple list or grid view
you require advanced state management or networking features
strengths: Easy to integrate via a single dependency
Supports multiple layouts and custom animations
Works on Android, iOS, web, and desktop
weaknesses: No support for advanced features like lazy loading or remote data fetching
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and run flutter pub get
